Controls.Title: Bivouac
Controls.SetLanding: Set this scene as the Bivouac landing page

Notify.LandingSet: This scene is now the Bivouac landing page.
Notify.NotLanding: Switch to the Bivouac landing scene to add widgets.

Confirm.ClearLandingBody: This removes the Bivouac landing-page designation from this scene. Your widgets are kept, but the board will no longer appear. You can set it again anytime.
Confirm.DeleteBody: Delete {count} widget(s)? This cannot be undone.

Edit.AddHint: Choose a widget to add to the landing page.

DMScreen.Title: DM Screen
DMScreen.Empty: No tools yet. Use + to add a widget.

DmTabPad.Name: DM screen tab — edge padding
DmTabPad.Hint: Horizontal gap (px) the DM-screen toggle tab keeps to the left of the sidebar. Increase it to clear other UI docked there, such as a party HUD.

DmTabTop.Name: DM screen tab — vertical position
DmTabTop.Hint: Vertical position of the DM-screen toggle tab, as a percentage of the screen height (0 = top, 50 = middle, 100 = bottom).
